posts.content_md:
> **DannyBruza:** I have found that i get much better results when i use acitic acid (photo stop bath)..only for 10 to 20 seconds before the fixer, ive tried this three time... each time i get very bright results...i dont know why...this is very interesting

Acetic acid is a weak solvent for gelatin. It may actually hydrolize ("soften") gelatin to some extent.

In addition with Cr hardening controlling pH value may play a key role for crosslinking.
